subject: Scout Accelerator onboarding & intake - next steps

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@scoutech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scout Accelerator — enablement intake and procurement contact

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Scoutech is excited about the potential for Redwood to power a pre-built assistant we’re rolling out to three of our largest clients. We’d like to move forward with a short pilot ("Scout Accelerator") to validate runbooks, run a joint enablement week, and capture a reseller playbook.

Folks who should be involved from our side: Oliver Grant (myself), Emily Smith (technical lead), and procurement@scoutech.com for SOW/PO.

Can you share:
- A proposed enablement cadence (what a 2-week sprint looks like)
- A sample intake template for scoping (systems, data paths, integrations)
- A rough commercial model for a pilot (any pilot discounts / terms)

Attaching a quick intake sheet so your team can pre-populate what you need (scoutech-intake-template.xlsx).

Appreciate a plan and a proposed kickoff week — we’re targeting the week of May 20.

Best,
Oliver
Director, Solutions & Partnerships
Scoutech Consulting

Attachment: scoutech-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@scoutech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Accelerator — enablement intake and procurement contact

Hi Oliver — great to hear from you and thanks for the intake sheet. We can absolutely support a two-week pilot + enablement sprint. High-level proposal below; I’ve attached a short accelerator outline for the SI kickoff.

High-level enablement cadence (two-week model):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, remote): intake review, network/credentials checklist, security questionnaire (shared doc)
- Week 1 (workshop + hands-on): architectural deep-dive, integration patterns, model profiles and prompt engineering sessions, shadowing of demo flows
- Week 2 (runbooks + handover): ops playbook, KV/prefix cache recommendations, performance baselining, go/no-go milestones and customer-facing handoff

Roles we’ll put on the thread: Naomi (solutions architect, will run tech sessions), Marissa (partner enablement lead, will run curriculum and certification), and Priyom (program manager, will coordinate SOW and billing).

Kickoff availability: we can support week of May 20-24; suggested dates May 21-24 for the on-site/remote workshop blocks.

I’m attaching: redwood-accelerator-outline.pdf (outline + agenda) and a short security summary we typically send to SIs. Will follow up with a light SOW template and commercial options — tagging Priyom for pricing.

Quick ask: can Emily or procurement confirm the primary procurement contact and any PO timing constraints?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-accelerator-outline.pdf (1 page), redwood-security-summary.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@scoutech.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 May 2029 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Accelerator — enablement intake and procurement contact

Thanks, Evelyn and Oliver. Quick clarifications from the enablement side:

- Curriculum split: we recommend three tracks during the hands-on week — Integration (APIs / auth / networking), Ops (dedicated vs. hosted routing, caching), and Prompt & Eval (prompt engineering + quality checks). We can certify 2-3 Scoutech engineers during the week.
- Deliverables: SI runbook, customer demo kit, and a two-week success criteria doc (we'll finalize success metrics during kickoff).
- Logistics: Do you want the week to be mostly remote with two half-day on-site sessions or full remote? Our recommendation for efficiency is remote pre-work + two half-day in-person labs if you can host.

Oliver — attaching a brief SOW checklist we use to expedite procurement (scoutech-sow-procurement-questions.docx). If procurement needs a fixed-price estimate we can produce a pilot quote by EOD Tue, May 7.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Partner Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: scoutech-sow-procurement-questions.docx (document stub)

Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scout Accelerator — enablement intake and procurement contact

Thanks everyone — confirming procurement contact is procurement@scoutech.com (cc’d). Emily (cc) will take the technical intake offline with Naomi.

We prefer the remote-first approach with two half-day on-site labs (we can host a customer day on May 23). Procurement expects a fixed-price pilot SOW and an itemized invoice to attach to the PO. Our timeline is tight — would need the quote and SOW draft by EOD May 8 to route internally.

Attached our internal network/security summary so you can pre-check anything sensitive (scoutech-security-summary.pdf).

Oliver
